Why is my cryptocurrency sale on hold?
Starting 25 June 2026, crypto buys will be paused due to regulatory updates. You can still hold and sell crypto. We expect crypto buys to return by the end of the year.
Why is my payment on hold or unavailable?
Your crypto sale / crypto sale proceeds may be on hold due to the unique activity profile of your account. PayPal holds funds for a variety of reasons based on the activity of the account.
Check your
account
for specific reasons as to why we are holding your money and to learn how you can release it.
Is there a hold when I sell my cryptocurrency?
If you buy cryptocurrencies but we have not yet received the cleared purchase funds from you, we are entitled to retain the proceeds of any sale by you of your cryptocurrencies pending our receipt of those cleared purchase funds.
We may place a temporary hold on these funds while they are pending (note the hold may not be released if we do not receive cleared purchase funds or if there is another issue with the payment or the account). As with all transactions, crypto sales are subject to review and could be delayed or stopped if there is an issue.
Why are the payments for the sale of cryptocurrency placed on hold?
Holds can be placed on a cryptocurrency sell transaction during a bank transfer (or where another issue with the payment or the account is identified). When the cryptocurrency sale is on hold during a bank transfer, the funds being transferred from your bank have not cleared in the original purchasing transaction. The temporary hold on the funds will be released upon the outstanding amount clearing.
Keep in mind that not all sell transactions will be put on hold. A hold may not be released if the payment transferred from your bank does not clear or if another issue with the payment or the account is identified.
How long will the sell transaction (payment) be on hold?
The hold time will vary depending on several risk factors, such as the amount waiting to be cleared from the bank transfer, and can generally take up to 8 days.
Will future transactions be held?
We cannot say with 100% certainty that no holds will be placed in the future, but if your account is in good standing then there is usually no reason for us to raise any concerns about your account.
Why is my withdrawal from PayPal on hold?
To provide a safe online payment service our internal security system reviews every transaction before it is released. Usually, withdrawals can take anywhere from 2-72 hrs to complete through our system. Generally, they'll complete within 2 hours; however, we occasionally hold a withdrawal for further review.
These reviews of withdrawals can happen for various reasons. For example, you may have received an amount of money that is larger than usual for your account, you may be logging in from an unsecured network or you may have made changes to your account Settings recently.
Once we have finished our review your withdrawal will show as ‘completed’ and will be processed to your bank account, providing that the review has not turned up any issues. Withdrawals to bank accounts can take up to 8 working days depending upon your bank's processing times.

Hey bunqers 🌈,
Get started with crypto safely, right from your bunq app. Choose from a wide range of cryptocurrencies - buying and selling takes just a tap.
Read more below to explore all the features available in your Crypto Tab.
How can I access my Crypto tab?
Set up your crypto wallet, buy, sell or swap coins whenever you like, all from your Crypto Tab.
To access your Crypto Tab, you can:
Open your bunq app
Go to your Crypto tab
Read more below to find out what actions are available to you from your Crypto tab.
Who can use bunq Crypto?
This feature is available to users who:
Have a verified bunq Personal account
Be 18 years or older
Have a verified residential address
Live in 🇦🇹 Austria, 🇧🇪 Belgium, 🇧🇬 Bulgaria, 🇭🇷 Croatia, 🇨🇾 Cyprus, 🇨🇿 Czech Republic, 🇩🇰 Denmark, 🇪🇪 Estonia, 🇫🇮 Finland, 🇫🇷 France, 🇩🇪 Germany, 🇬🇷 Greece, 🇭🇺 Hungary, 🇮🇸 Iceland, 🇮🇪 Ireland, 🇮🇹 Italy, 🇱🇻 Latvia, 🇱🇮 Liechtenstein, 🇱🇹 Lithuania, 🇱🇺 Luxembourg, 🇲🇹 Malta, 🇳🇱 Netherlands, 🇳🇴 Norway, 🇵🇱 Poland, 🇵🇹 Portugal, 🇷🇴 Romania, 🇸🇰 Slovakia, 🇸🇮 Slovenia, 🇪🇸 Spain or 🇸🇪 Sweden
How can I start investing in crypto?
You can invest in crypto without leaving the bunq app. To get started, all you have to do is create a personal crypto wallet. Follow the steps below:
Go to the
Crypto tab
Tap on
Buy Crypto
Complete the verification flow for Kraken
Your wallet is now ready ✅
How can I buy crypto?
Buying crypto is super easy. Pay directly from the Bank Account of your choice and get started. Here’s how:
Crypto tab.
Tap 🔵 Buy
Choose the cryptocurrency you want to buy
Enter the amount you want to buy
Choose which Bank Account you want to use for the purchase
Slide to Buy
Done 🎉
You can also easily buy a cryptocurrency directly from its detail screen by tapping the “Buy” button at the bottom. It’s a fast and convenient way to invest.
You can buy crypto from as little as
€1.
How can I sell crypto?
Tap 🟠 Sell
Choose the cryptocurrency you want to sell
Enter the amount you want to sell or “Sell All”
(amount will auto-fill with your full balance of this currency)
Choose the Bank Account you want to use for the sell
Slide to sell
To sell your crypto, the trade amount needs to be at least
Why can't I sell my Crypto?
Sometimes, you may not be able to sell a cryptocurrency right away. This happens when there aren't enough buyers in the market at that moment - this is called
low liquidity
Crypto liquidity
is how easily a cryptocurrency can be bought or sold without causing a big change in its price. High liquidity means many buyers and sellers are active, so you can trade quickly. Low liquidity is the opposite, making it harder to complete trades.
Newly launched or less popular cryptocurrencies
often have lower liquidity. This can change fast depending on market activity. Well-known cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin (BTC) and Ethereum (ETH) usually have high liquidity because they're traded frequently by many people.
Remember:
Liquidity can change quickly in the crypto market. What's easy to sell today might be harder to sell tomorrow.
Where can I check the price of my trade?
Tap the ⓘ icon on the buy or sell screen. It shows exactly how much crypto you get for your money, service fee included, before you confirm.
That can look different from the market price shown on the buy or sell screen, which is the midpoint between two prices: the buy price is higher, the sell price is lower, and the gap between them is the spread.
Learn more about bunq Crypto
fees and spread
How can I swap crypto?
You can swap one cryptocurrency for another. For example, if you have Bitcoin and want Ethereum, you can simply swap your Bitcoin for Ethereum. Here’s how:
Tap
More
Select 🟢 Swap
Choose the cryptocurrency you own and the one you wanna swap it for
Enter the amount you want to swap
Slide to swap
To swap your crypto, the trade amount needs to be at least
How can I set price alerts?
Stay ahead of market movements and never miss your target price. Set price alerts and get notified when a coin reaches your chosen value. Here's how:
Choose the cryptocurrency you want to be alerted for
Tap the 🔔 in the top right corner
Select the price hit you want to be alerted for
Create Alert
How can I delete or edit a price alert?
You can change or remove your price alerts whenever you like. Here’s how:
Tap ⚙️ Settings
Select 🔔 Alerts
Select the alert you want to edit or delete
Adjust the sum or delete the alert
What is Crypto delisting?
To give you a secure crypto experience, we partner with Kraken. Sometimes, Kraken may decide to stop supporting a specific cryptocurrency — this is known as
delisting
. When a cryptocurrency is delisted, you will no longer be able to buy, sell, or trade it from your bunq app.
But don't worry, we've got your back. If you hold a cryptocurrency that is scheduled to be delisted, we'll always notify you, at least 2 business days in advance, to give you time to take action.
What are my options if I hold crypto which will be delisted?
If you hold a cryptocurrency that's being delisted, you've got two simple options:
Sell or swap your crypto:
You can sell the cryptocurrency or swap it for another available cryptocurrency before the delisting deadline.
Let us handle it for you:
If you miss the deadline or simply don’t take any action, no problem - we'll swap your crypto holdings into another cryptocurrency at the market rate. Please note that this may take
up to three
months to process.
In the meantime, your crypto will be securely stored in your Crypto Wallet.
Heads up:
After the delisting date, you won't be able to trade the cryptocurrency. Make sure to understand your options before the communicated deadline.
Why can crypto be delisted?
Cryptocurrencies are delisted from Kraken for various reasons related to performance and regulatory compliance. These decisions help protect you and maintain a safe trading environment. A cryptocurrency can get delisted for several reasons, including:
Keeping standards high:
A crypto may be delisted if it no longer meets the necessary standards for performance and security.
Protecting your assets:
If a cryptocurrency has security vulnerabilities, it may be delisted to protect you from potential risks while a replacement is sorted out.
Ensuring fair practices:
We only want to support projects that act in the best interest of the user community. If a project team engages in harmful behavior like market manipulation, its token will be removed.
Keeping your crypto up-to-date
: If a cryptocurrency gets a new name, Kraken automatically swaps your old currency for the new one — and the old version is then delisted.

How N26 Crypto works
The market for crypto assets and the purchase of crypto assets constitute a high risk. Crypto assets are subject to high fluctuations in value, and there is no real underlying asset. Declines in value or a rapid, complete loss of the money spent are possible at any time. Past performance is not a reliable indicator of future performance.
The values depicted above are fictional and for illustrative purposes only. The statements and illustrations do not constitute investment advice.
N26 Crypto is powered by Bitpanda Asset Management GmbH (HRB 121696), licensed by the German Federal Financial Supervisory Authority and located at Friedrich-Ebert-Anlage 36, 60325 Frankfurt, Germany.
Manage and monitor both cash and crypto in one place—from your N26 app. No need to download a new app or make a new account to start trading crypto, just scroll down from your bank account to check it out.
How to use N26 Crypto in your N26 app?
You can buy, sell and swap coins easily in the N26 app, to do so:
Tap the
Investments
tab and scroll to
Crypto
Search or choose a coin from the list
Select Buy, Sell, or Swap
Enter the amount you wish to buy, sell, or swap,
Preview your order and confirm it
Looking for an asset we don’t currently offer?
You can now let us know which stocks, ETFs, or cryptocurrencies you’d like us to add. Go to the Investments tab within your N26 app and type in the name of the asset that you’re looking for in the search bar at the top of your screen. A suggestion box will appear, in which you can submit your request directly to our Investments team. They will then ensure, when possible, that the asset gets added.
Why don’t I see N26 Crypto in my app?
Crypto is being rolled out gradually. If you don't see the feature in your app, it could be for one of the following reasons:
Country Availability:
N26 Crypto is currently only available to eligible customers in Austria, Belgium, Germany, Spain, France, Portugal and Ireland. We are working on expanding this feature to more countries.
Regulatory Eligibility:
Please note that, based on local applicable regulation, N26 reserves the right to determine final eligibility. Therefore, access to N26 Crypto may not be available to all customers, even in supported countries.
App Version:
To access N26 Crypto, always make sure your N26 app is fully up to date.
If you are in an eligible country and have the latest app version, please check back in several weeks as we may be rolling it out to customers in phases.
N26 Crypto Fees
Buying crypto doesn’t need to be costly. You only need €1 to get started and with N26 Crypto, you’ll pay
1.5% in fees on Bitcoin,
2.5% on other cryptocurrencies
and
3.5% on low-liquidity coins.
With a Metal account
, you get a discount on trading fees — pay
1% for Bitcoin
2% for other coins
. Metal plans also come with a Mastercard made of stainless steel, comprehensive travel and tech insurance, and dedicated customer support via phone 7 days a week.
The N26 Metal crypto fee discounts only apply to trading amounts up to €5,000 (including fees on purchasing and excluding fees on selling crypto) per calendar month. Above this amount, regular fees apply: 1.5% on Bitcoin and 2.5% on all other coins.
If you're
swapping
one cryptocurrency for another—like Bitcoin to Ethereum—you don’t need to make two separate transactions anymore. Swapping lets you do it all in one go, saving you time and money. Instead of paying two full trading fees (one for selling and one for buying), you’ll just pay a single,
discounted fee
of around 30% off the usual trading fees!
Just keep in mind the final fee might vary depending on the coins you’re swapping and your membership tier.
Please note that fees are always rounded up to the nearest full cent—to a maximum of one cent—which may lead to a slight increase of the fee percentage shown in an order preview).
The fees and cryptocurrency prices shown on the N26 app for every transaction and including a possible spread are not determined by N26 but provided by Bitpanda. N26's liability is expressly excluded for any claim or damage arising from the formation of the prices of the assets offered by Bitpanda.
Don’t forget that, unlike many crypto trading apps, the prices in the N26 app are in Euro.
For a full and detailed breakdown of all costs, please refer to our official
Crypto Pricing policy
(new tab)
N26 Crypto Limits
The following limits apply to trading crypto on N26:
A €50,000 limit on daily transactions by Personal customers
A €100,000 limit on daily transactions by Business customers
200 trades within 24 hours, per user
Users can only place buy and sell orders with a minimum of €1. This applies to all coins.
If you have some questions burning a hole in your pocket, view our Crypto page with FAQs.
Savings plans
We know our customers are looking for ways to streamline their investment process and minimize stress, aiming to steadily grow their wealth through regular contributions. To help our customers with this, we have now introduced Savings plans that can be applied to any crypto asset at no additional charge
(regular percentage fees apply based on the asset and if you are a Metal account holder).
Users can pick the asset they want to invest in, enter the amount to invest, and enter the frequency (weekly, every 2 weeks, monthly, or every 3 months). And there is no limit on the amount of plans you attach to your crypto assets.
We want to empower customers to concentrate on what truly matters: their objectives and strategies.
We’ve made investing even simpler for you
Your Savings plans are now unified in one seamless experience, making it easier than ever to view and manage all your plans‌ — ‌whether in Crypto, Stocks, or ETFs‌ — ‌right from your N26 app.
When setting up a new plan, you'll find Stocks, ETFs, and Crypto in one easy-to-navigate list. This streamlined setup helps you make regular contributions effortlessly and grow your wealth across different asset types, all in line with your financial goals.
What are Portfolio Groups?
Portfolio Groups help you organise your investments in the N26 app. Instead of seeing just one list of all your assets, you can create your own groups, name them, and assign specific assets to each group.
For example, you can create groups such as “Retirement”, “High risk”, or “Tech” and add the relevant assets to them. You can also mix different types of investments in the same Portfolio Group – for instance, crypto, stocks and funds. This can help you:
Organise your portfolio according to your own strategy or goals.
Better understand how diversified your overall portfolio is.
How Portfolio Groups work
Open your N26 app and go to your investments.
Select
Start
on the “Organize your portfolio with Groups.” infocard.
Create a new Portfolio Group and choose a name for it.
Assign one or more assets to this group.
You can edit a group later, move assets to a different group, or delete a group.
Notes
Deleting a Portfolio Group does not close or sell your positions. It only changes how your portfolio is organised and displayed in the app.
Each asset can only be in one Portfolio Group. If you add one asset to a group, it is automatically removed from the group it’s currently in.
Important to know
Portfolio Groups are only a way to structure and view your assets. They do not change how you buy or sell investments, and they do not affect fees, limits, or market execution.
You can still see the total value and performance of your portfolio across all groups.
How you name and use your Portfolio Groups is entirely up to you and does not constitute investment advice.
I can’t find Portfolio Groups
If you do not see Portfolio Groups in your N26 app, this feature may not be available for your account yet. Features can be released gradually and may not be visible to all customers at the same time.
Good to know before getting started
In order to be able to buy, sell or swap Crypto you have to have a correct, registered and valid
Tax ID
. In case you don’t know where to find your Tax ID or how to register it in your app, please visit our
Support Page
14-day revocation right
As a N26 customer, you can exercise your 14-day revocation right directly via the new in-app Withdrawal button, located under
My account
Legal documents
Withdraw from contract
. This is a mandatory, one-click, frictionless mechanism required by EU Directive 2023/2673. The button is available in the mobile app only.
